Subject: Case study localization & consent: TechRise + SmartScan

Hi Anna and Kenji,

Thanks again for the great participation during the Q3 reference interviews — the case details will make a strong piece for our joint materials. Marketing is ready to draft a short case study, and we wanted to confirm two things before we proceed:

1) Localization: we'd like to publish the case study in German (for EU/NL/DE channels) and Japanese (for APAC). Can you confirm whether we have permission to translate the customer quote excerpts and the short summary into those languages?

2) Consent: to be GDPR-friendly and have a clear audit trail, we typically use a short localization consent DocuSign that covers translated text and small brand/quote edits. I’ve attached a redacted draft of the case study and a localization checklist.

If this looks fine I can send the DocuSign to each of you (one for TechRise, one for SmartScan). If there are legal or procurement reviewers who must sign, please loop them in.

Attachments: redacted_case_study_v1.pdf, localization_checklist_v2.xlsx

Requested next steps: reply with any redlines or confirm I should send the DocuSign by end of week.

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-ready LLM inference for developers
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@techrise.de>

Date: 2026-11-16T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Case study localization & consent: TechRise + SmartScan

Hi Priyom,

Appreciate the draft and flag — this is promising. A couple of quick questions from our side before we can sign off on translations:

- GDPR/data handling: are any customer-specific logs, query examples, or screenshots included in the final document? If so, we need to see redacted versions and a short note on data retention for the published assets.
- Localized brand usage: TechRise has a registered German trade name variant (TechRise GmbH) and a stylized product name in German marketing materials. Could Marketing confirm that the localization will preserve the TechRise brand guidelines?

I looked at redacted_case_study_v1.pdf — the quote looks fine, but can you share the final screenshot assets that would appear inline? We prefer to approve visuals separately from text.

If everything is text-only and screenshots are redacted, we can likely approve the translation consent next week. Please add our Legal contact if DocuSign needs an additional signatory.

Best,
Anna
Senior Marketing Manager
TechRise GmbH
anna.schmidt@techrise.de

Quick legal/ops note — we can proceed with the localization consent as a short addendum (no need for a full SLA amendment). Key points:

- Keep screenshots redacted or obfuscated (no PII or customer data).
- The localization consent template covers translated text and minor copy edits; it does NOT permit changes to the core customer quote without explicit approval from the customer (we'll surface that on the DocuSign).
- For EU -> DE publication: confirm that the German company name variant is used where appropriate (TechRise GmbH). For APAC -> JP: confirm whether SmartScan prefers katakana or English product names in the headline.

I’ve attached the redacted case study (redacted_case_study_v1.pdf) with the screenshot placeholders removed and the localization checklist. Priyom, please send the DocuSign to Anna + Kenji and cc legal if they want to countersign. Add Marissa on the envelope so Marketing can approve final wording.
